# Run-to-run spread (auto-generated by seed_spread.py)

Pooled out-of-sample accuracy over 4232 days, 30 walk-forward runs from 30 different seeds (none shared with run.py). Always-up scores 55.20%.

| Configuration | Runs | Mean | Std. dev. (pts) | Min | Max | Range (pts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single MLP, new seed each run | 30 | 54.81% | 0.41 | 53.80% | 55.36% | 1.56 |
| Average of 5 MLPs, new seeds each run | 6 | 55.16% | 0.22 | 54.94% | 55.55% | 0.61 |

- Single-model runs that beat always-up: 5 of 30.
- 5-model averages that beat always-up: 2 of 6.
- With seeds fixed (run.py), repeated runs on the same machine are identical, so the spread is zero.
- One single-model walk-forward (17 folds) took 2.4 s on average.
